csv_scope_of_work: FXSB 26-7337 Repair Replace Hangar Roof B11551. title: Design-Build for Hangar Roof Repair and Replacement - B11551
short_description: Design-build tender for repairing and replacing the roof of an Air Force hangar.
project_scope: Repair and replacement of the roof at Hangar B11551. The project includes removal of the existing built-up roof from the barrel-shaped center roof section and three lower lean-to roof sections down to the structural decking. A new fully adhered 3-ply SBS-modified built-up roof with granular cap sheet is to be installed on the barrel roof, while the three lean-to sections are to receive new fully adhered 90-mil EPDM roof assemblies. The works also include replacement of roof drains, flashings, vent pipe flashing, cover board, insulation, vapor barrier, cant strips, metal copings, and trim.
services: Design-build services for roof rehabilitation and replacement, including civil engineering, structural engineering, refurbishment, and construction/project management.
relevance_explanation:
- Primarily a roof repair and replacement project with limited structural innovation.

- Hangar building type could be of some interest, but no long-span structural redesign is described.
- Tender is design-build and includes structural engineering, which adds minor strategic relevance.
- Small business set-aside may further limit suitability.
fee_explanation: No explicit planning fee is stated in the source. The notice only provides a total construction cost of 19,000,000 USD for a design-build roof rehabilitation project.
